title: A member someone blocked can no longer reach them through Contact the seller

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18: submitListingContact opens a DM and inserts the message with the admin client, with no block check

detail: 2026-11-18: findOrCreateDirectConversation leaves the block policy to its caller. sendMessage, the service enquiry and message the host each call isBlockedBetween first; submitListingContact (Contact the seller, and make an offer) did not, so a blocked member could still open a thread with the person who blocked them and land a message through the admin client. It now refuses before opening the thread. Still open: the participants_send_messages RLS policy does not check blocks, so a pre-existing thread can be written straight through PostgREST (separate row).

verify.note: Fails on main: no block check in submitListingContact.
